# Support Audit

> Support Audit is an independent audit service for supported exempt accommodation (SEA) and transitional supported housing in England. It audits resident support files for Registered Providers and managing agents and rates each file Gold, Green, Amber or Red, with the reason for every rating.

Audits are desktop reviews of resident records, carried out remotely or at the provider's office. Every finding names the document, the date and what good looks like. An experienced auditor makes every judgement and sets every grade. Based in Solihull, West Midlands; serving England.

## Services
- [Audits](https://supportaudit.co.uk/audits/): Mock Audit, audit rounds and monitoring compared, the full checklist, the rating key and how audits map to the National Supported Housing Standards
- [Use cases](https://supportaudit.co.uk/use-cases/): nine situations where providers use an independent audit

## Guides
- [Risk management plans that pass a support audit](https://supportaudit.co.uk/resources/risk-management-plan-supported-housing-2026/): an eight-point checklist for risk assessments and risk management plans (risk described for the resident, score matching the file, a plan for every risk above threshold, specific actions with named owners, the resident's view, review dates and reviews after incidents, actions visible in session notes), a weak and a strong invented example, what the draft licensing regulations and the proposed environment and safeguarding standards say, and a five-file self-check
- [Auditing digital support records: AI-padded notes, hazard alerts and timestamps](https://supportaudit.co.uk/resources/auditing-digital-support-records-ai-notes-2026/): four checks for digital support files (generic or AI-padded session notes with no plan goal or action, hazard alerts that must end in an owned repair job, entry timestamp patterns such as batches of near-identical notes, templates that allow saving without a goal and next action), rules for frontline tech use and a ten-minute self-check
- [Individual support plan goals that pass an audit](https://supportaudit.co.uk/resources/individual-support-plan-goals-2026/): the four things a support plan goal needs (the assessed need, an outcome agreed with the resident, the level and type of support and who gives it, a review of progress and barriers), a weak and a strong invented example, what the proposed person-centred support standard says, and a five-plan self-check
- [How to write case notes that pass a support audit](https://supportaudit.co.uk/resources/how-to-write-case-notes-support-audit-2026/): the six things a support session note needs (date and times, who was there, what was done, the support plan goal, risks raised, next action and owner), a weak and a strong invented example, and a ten-note self-check
- [Awaab's Law Phase 2: when a support note starts the clock](https://supportaudit.co.uk/resources/awaabs-law-phase-2-support-records-2026/): who Awaab's Law covers in supported housing (tenancy, not licence), when the clock starts, the Phase 2 timescales from 30 November 2026 and how support staff should log hazards
- [The ASHA inquiry: why auditors must flag conflicts of interest](https://supportaudit.co.uk/resources/asha-inquiry-auditors-flag-conflicts-interest-support-2026/): the 3 November 2026 RSH statutory inquiry into Ash-Shahada Housing Association, and what support-file audits should check on conflicts of interest and third-party payments
- [Draft licensing rules: how to audit files for the 2026 National Standards](https://supportaudit.co.uk/resources/audit-files-national-standards-licensing-2026/): what resident files must show before draft licensing regulations, including the four-week needs assessment and the fit and proper person test
- [Supported housing licensing explained](https://supportaudit.co.uk/resources/supported-housing-licensing/): the Supported Housing (Regulatory Oversight) Act 2023, the National Supported Housing Standards, who needs a licence and when
- [What a good resident support file contains](https://supportaudit.co.uk/resources/resident-support-file/): the ten core documents, common gaps and a self-check
- [Resources](https://supportaudit.co.uk/resources/): quick answers, key dates, a 22-term glossary and primary sources
